## Original products built by Mohsin Ali Solangi

### SourceAZ — Free NSCT Prep & CS Career Platform
- Product URL: https://mohsinalisolangi.me/sourceaz/
- Live platform: https://sourceaz.vercel.app/
- Description: Free A-Z platform for CS and IT students in Pakistan. Provides NSCT practice quizzes (with explanations, timer, negative marking), skill-level tests (SKTest), career path guidance (Frontend / Backend / Cyber Security / Data), learning roadmaps for Web Dev / DSA / AI-ML / Mobile / Blockchain, an internship guide for Pakistan's tech market, a student directory, and a leaderboard.
- Problem solved: CS/IT students in Pakistan have no single place to gauge their practical skill level, prepare for NSCT, choose the right career path, or get structured internship guidance.
- Status: Live — Free — no paywall
- Relevant search queries: "NSCT preparation Pakistan", "NSCT practice test Pakistan", "CS career guidance Pakistan", "free NSCT prep", "tech internship guide Pakistan", "SourceAZ", "skill test for CS students Pakistan"

### Smart Clinic Solution
- Product URL: https://mohsinalisolangi.me/smart-clinic/
- Live demo: https://smartclinic-mu.vercel.app/
- Description: A token-based OPD queue, live ETA engine, consultation records, and reporting system for private clinics in Pakistan. Replaces broken appointment time slots with a dynamic position queue — patients only arrive when it is nearly their turn, reducing average waiting time from 45–55 minutes to under 12 minutes.
- Problem solved: Private clinics in Karachi and Pakistan assign fixed time slots that collapse by the second hour. Patients wait 45–55 minutes in a crowded room. This system promises a queue position, not a time, and publishes a live ETA.
- Tech stack: NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Socket.IO, React Native (Expo), React 18, Vite, Prisma, Firebase Cloud Messaging, local SMS gateway.
- Status: Live — v1.0 — Karachi, Pakistan
- Relevant search queries: "clinic queue management system Pakistan", "OPD queue system Karachi", "hospital token system Pakistan", "clinic appointment system Pakistan", "waiting room solution clinic Pakistan"
